[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/4d850a935f781acdbf842639ad5d0defe20e49af.png[/img]

[b]Functional[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed reputation loss/gain from damaging characters (NPCs such as Wolves and Spiders count as characters)
[*] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/c12fed72990f358d2c6f4802802216fd586b48b8.png[/img] Fixed an issue with Factions where existing improperly removed dead NPC IDs were colliding with existing player character IDs
[*] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/c12fed72990f358d2c6f4802802216fd586b48b8.png[/img] Fixed an issue with Factions where new player characters matched IDs with improperly removed dead NPC IDs and ended up in the SPID faction by coincidence
[*] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/c12fed72990f358d2c6f4802802216fd586b48b8.png[/img] Fixed an issue with Jump Drives where jumps were prevented/truncated by planet influence when jumping away even if outside gravity range
[*] Fixed an issue with Jump Drives where jumps were prevented/truncated by whole grids being in the way - now jumps are prevented at the block level (jump path intersects with a block space)
[*] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/c12fed72990f358d2c6f4802802216fd586b48b8.png[/img] Fixed an issue with MP where the game would not unpause itself after joining a Friend's game through Steam Overlay UI and trying to spawn[/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with Chat whisper function where it allowed tabbing through spawned NPCs in addition to Players as potential whisper targets
[*] Fixed an issue with VRage remote/DSGUI where NPCs were listed as Players[/list]
[b]Modding[/b]
[list]
[*] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/c12fed72990f358d2c6f4802802216fd586b48b8.png[/img] Fixed an issue with Factions where the IMyFactionCollection.KickPlayerFromFaction did not actually kick the player correctly and just cleared the mapping
[*] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/c12fed72990f358d2c6f4802802216fd586b48b8.png[/img] Fixed an issue with Jump Drives where jumps were prevented/truncated by modded entities (i.e. Shields) - modded entities without collisions should no longer be visible for Jump checks[/list]

notes.title: Announcing the “Sounds of Next Frontier” - Space Engineers 2 Music Competition!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/04a086f60a93862ae7b0a8945ea71f6d770d83ab.jpg[/img]
[h3]SUMMARY[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Submission Start: Monday, September 15, 2025[/b]
[*] [b]Deadline for Submissions: Monday, November 24, 2025[/b]
[*] Create and submit Space Engineers 2 inspired music tracks for your chance to have them implemented into our games and published on our official youtube channel! Winners will also receive additional prizes in the form of Steam gift cards.
[*] The [b]top 10[/b] entries will be chosen by the KeenSWH team.
[*] The winners will be announced on the “Sounds of Next Frontier” livestream with Karel Antonin (music composer of Space Engineers 1 and 2) on [b]Friday, December 12, 2025[/b][/list]
Hello Engineers!

We are excited to announce another music competition, this time as “Sounds of Next Frontier” for Space Engineers 2!

Have you got some musical skill and a passion for the stars? This competition gives you the chance to have a music track inspired by Space Engineers 2 that you create featured in our games and on our official youtube channel. On top of this, winners will also receive steam gift cards.

Your entry could evoke classic vibes of the game, or be a truly original take on it! It could be slower or faster, dramatic or relaxed - any music genre you want.

Our past two Music Competitions were some of the most memorable experiences for us, and we can’t wait to hear the musical masterpieces you create this time. Good luck!

[previewyoutube=uLGudgPXnpo;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]HOW TO SUBMIT[/h3]
[list]
[*] Please submit your entries to community@keenswh.com with the subject line: “Sounds of Next Frontier”
[*] Entries must be submitted in MP3 or WAV format. You can submit your music via Google drive links.
[*] Each contestant can submit as many entries as they like, but each contestant can only win once.
[*] Minimum score length is 60 seconds and the maximum length is 5 minutes.
[*] Submissions that contain “sampled ” or derivative work must include references to the original work.
[*] Do not use any copyrighted material in your music. If you do use copyrighted material in your music track, make sure you have permission to use it or you’re the owner of the copyrighted material.[/list]Make sure that you read the rules carefully, so you know all of the contest guidelines before creating your musical score!

[h3]EVALUATION & RESULTS[/h3]
[list]
[*] The period for submissions is beginning Monday, September 15th, 2025 and concluding Monday, November 24, 2025.
[*] During the following period, we will review all submissions to ensure quality and that the rules have been adhered to. From the eligible entries, we will choose 10 winners.
[*] The winners will be announced on Friday, December 12th, 2025.[/list]
[h3]PRIZES[/h3]
[list]
[*] The winning tracks will be permanently uploaded to our YouTube Channel as individual videos and/or as a compilation.
[*] Winners will receive a EUR 50 Steam gift card.
[*] The winning music tracks will be available in Space Engineers 1 via the sound block and jukebox. (Please note: this is subject to the artistic vision of Keen Software House. Additionally, the authors of the tracks consent to having their submission added to the game when entering this competition.)[/list]
[h3]RULES & LEGAL[/h3]
[list]
[*] [url=https://2.spaceengineersgame.com/sounds-of-next-frontier-space-engineers-2-music-competition/]https://2.spaceengineersgame.com/sounds-of-next-frontier-space-engineers-2-music-competition/[/url][/list]

notes.title: Space Engineers: Apex Survival Live Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/8faec2e8bb1967128774465c099a4bba4afb2099.jpg[/img]
Hello, Engineers!

We’re excited to introduce [b]Apex Survival[/b], the next major evolution of Space Engineers. This free update brings new survival mechanics to the game, adding [b]food, farming, environmental hazards, meaningful death[/b] and a brand-new [b]buff system[/b]. 

Everything is [b]optional and fully configurable[/b] – you can fine-tune the experience to suit your playstyle. Whether you want a hardcore survival challenge where venturing outside a grid is a constant threat, or a relaxed farming loop while building your perfect base, Apex Survival lets you decide how to play.

The [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3858380/Space_Engineers__Apex_Survival_Pack/]Apex Survival Pack[/url][/b] includes new decorative blocks accompanying this update – perfect for bringing your bases to life. Add lush greenery, detailed grow spaces, and new design variants to create habitats that feel vibrant and lived-in.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3858380/Space_Engineers__Apex_Survival_Pack/
[list][*] [url=https://www.spaceengineersgame.com/space-engineers-apex-survival-live-now/]Full Blog Post[/url]
[*] Guides: [list]
[*] [url=https://www.spaceengineersgame.com/new-players/survival-guide-food/]Survival Guide: Food[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.spaceengineersgame.com/new-players/survival-guide-buffs/]Survival Guide: Buffs[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.spaceengineersgame.com/new-players/survival-guide-radiation/]Survival Guide: Radiation[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.spaceengineersgame.com/new-players/survival-guide-weather/]Survival Guide: Weather[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.spaceengineersgame.com/modding-guides/modding-guide-weather-effects/]Modding Guide: Weather Effects[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.spaceengineersgame.com/modding-guides/modding-guide-automatic-weather-system/]Modding Guide: Automatic Weather System[/url][/list][*] [url=https://support.keenswh.com/spaceengineers]Support Portal[/url][/list]
[previewyoutube=61KnpGOhqJ0;full][/previewyoutube]
We’re bringing you all the important gameplay changes for free in our Apex Survival Update.

[b]You don’t need to start a brand-new world[/b] to experience the new features (including the new Space encounters) – they can all be enabled on your old saves.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/29405aa86202fef9e6b70e7945f30dc779627432.png[/img]

Food is now a core survival mechanic in Apex Survival, enabled by default in all new survival worlds (and off by default in creative mode). A new food bar has been added to the HUD when enabled, giving you another vital resource to manage.

Food consumption is customizable with a new world setting:
[list]
[*] Disabled – Food system is off
[*] Slow – 3 hours from full to empty
[*] Moderate (Default) – 1.5 hours
[*] Fast – 45 minutes[/list]Let your food bar run dry, and you’ll take damage until death. Drop below 20% food and you’ll face debuffs – losing 1% movement speed per missing percent, and eventually losing the ability to sprint entirely.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/94daa0cdb07ffef670d0c14d5aa3151d032dd673.jpg[/img]
[h3]🥕 Food Items & Ingredients [/h3]
Apex Survival introduces 9 new food items that act as ingredients for crafting [b]Meal Packs[/b]. While many of these can be eaten raw in a pinch, their nutritional value is limited – combining them into prepared meals is the key to efficient survival. Planning your food supply and crafting recipes will give you a big advantage when living off the land.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/f740e907852e89eaa87754f418822699a785312b.png[/img]
[h3]🌿 Foraging, Hunting, and Obtaining Food Items[/h3]
Food in Apex Survival comes from a variety of sources. [b]Algae[/b] is your most basic and accessible food source, harvested using the [b]Algae Farm[/b] block. It's not glamorous, but it gets the job done, making it ideal for early survival in any environment.

Other ingredients can be found through foraging, hunting, and exploration:
[list]
[*] New forageable bushes spawn across Pertam, Earthlike and Alien planets. Earthlike is the richest in vegetation, while Pertam is sparse and Alien is rich in edible mushrooms.
[*] These can be harvested by hand or via Collector blocks, and they will respawn over time if cleanup conditions are met.
[*] Wolves now drop Mammal Meat, and Sabiroids drop Insect Meat.
[*] NPCs and Encounters may contain lootable food items, especially in kitchen areas.
[*] Unknown Signals often hold seeds, and NPC Trade Stations sell both seeds and food supplies.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/f96c08bb578187e31f429ec89e410d70dd00ef72.jpg[/img]
[h3]🌱 Harvesting Seeds[/h3]
To start farming, you’ll need seeds - and that’s where the [b]Food Processor[/b] comes in. Inside its production menu, you’ll find a "Harvesting" category that allows you to convert Fruit, Grain, Mushroom, and Vegetable items into Seed or Spore Packs. These can then be placed in [b]Farm Plots[/b] to begin growing your own renewable food sources.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/272b6cf649865b47361b32a68f5e147ce499701c.png[/img]
[h3]🌾 Farming[/h3]
Farming in Apex Survival is split between two key blocks: the [b]Algae Farm[/b] and the [b]Farm Plot[/b].

[b]Algae Farms[/b] are low-maintenance, sunlight-driven blocks that generate [b]Algae[/b] over time. They don’t require special components or upkeep, but their output depends entirely on sun exposure. They’re a great early-game food source and work well in most situations.

[b]Farm Plots[/b] are more complex but also far more rewarding. These blocks require active maintenance and care to function efficiently. They come with an internal water tank that must be filled via an attached [b]Irrigation System[/b] - a block that processes ice into water for your crops. No water means dead crops.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/d383452da77b7f5eb2eabccef18709c9619036dc.jpg[/img]
Farm Plots grow [b]Fruit, Grain, Mushrooms[/b], and [b]Vegetables[/b], each with unique growth speeds, water consumption, and yields. Crops have health values and are sensitive to environmental factors:
[list]
[*] Running out of water causes gradual health loss.
[*] Exposure to vacuum or extreme temperatures kills crops in seconds.
[*] Damaging the plot kills the crop.
[*] Grinding the plot removes the crop.
[*] Crops below 100% health can still be harvested, but with reduced yield.[/list]Each crop passes through multiple growth stages, and once fully grown, water consumption drops by 90%, allowing you to leave crops as decorative elements with minimal upkeep.

Farming interactions:
[list]
[*] Manual Harvest: Use the management screen to collect crops directly into your inventory.
[*] Automated Harvest: Use a Collector on a subgrid placed near the plot to harvest automatically into your grid’s inventory. (Same-grid collection is not supported.)[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/7bde3425d38c35420c9262da154410e27441cc35.png[/img]
[b]Farming Tips[/b]
[list]
[*] Water Is Life: The Farm Plot has an internal water tank. It must be filled via an Irrigation System, which processes ice into usable water. Without water, crops quickly lose health and may die.
[*] Power Matters: The Farm Plot consumes 20 watts of power. Turning it off disables the light and water intake – but crops will still grow and consume water. Only damage or disabling the block will kill the crop instantly.
[*] The built-in light on the Farm Plot is for ambiance only and has no gameplay impact. Turning off the block disables the light and stops water from refilling, but crops will still grow as normal. 
[*] Growth & Harvest: Each crop type has a full lifecycle with health, growth stages, and a recovery rate. Once mature, they can be harvested manually or automatically using collectors (on subgrids only). If a crop’s health drops to zero, it will perish.
[*] Mod-Friendly Design: The Farm Plot supports a wide array of customization for mods, including multiple seed types, growth models, recovery rates, and water needs. Modders can define custom behavior and visuals per crop type – even requiring more seeds for larger plot types.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/93c4d7fb087700d6941f0e32c8ebf8f1d3c3d18e.jpg[/img]
[h3]🥩 Meal Pack Crafting[/h3]
Survival in Apex isn't just about finding food - it's about making it count. The [b]Survival Kit[/b] can craft the most basic ration: [b]Kelp Crisp[/b], made solely from algae. It’s low-effort, low-impact, and great in a pinch.

For more advanced meals, you’ll need the [b]Food Processor[/b]. This block serves as a more advanced crafting hub for all food items. In addition to cooking raw Mammal and Insect Meat, making them safe to eat, it offers a  wide variety of Meal Pack recipes that use multiple ingredients. The more complex the recipe, the better the food’s nutritional value and the longer it will sustain you.

And good news, everyone: Food never spoils - so you can stock up and prepare in advance for longer journeys or hostile environments.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/116aa67d7cde79540c075ad9108ff6acf90a89df.png[/img]
[h3]🎁 Looted/Easter Egg Food Items[/h3]
We’ve also added rare, loot-only consumables that can’t be crafted in the Food Processor and are only found through exploration, encounters, or looting NPCs. But beware - not everything you scavenge is safe. Some of these "delicacies" might come with unexpected (or unpleasant) side effects.

Are you hungry enough to take the risk? You never know - it might just be worth it…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/7bd6305b2186c0d0cc2ec021860ab94dc0f69d41.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/2b78aa49f8a790339eb56a6d15ab1f86ef990597.png[/img]

Apex Survival introduces new mechanics that can make staying alive more rewarding – and dying more costly.

[h3]New World Option: Reduced Stats on Respawn[/h3]
To raise the stakes, the new [b]Reduced Stats on Respawn[/b] world option starts you at just 20% across all vitals (health, food, energy, oxygen, and hydrogen) when you respawn outside of a starter craft. It’s no longer just a quick reset – death has become something to avoid.

[h3]New World Option: Survival Buffs[/h3]
With the new [b]Survival Buff system[/b], your character gains powerful bonuses for surviving the dangers of the frontier. Every 45 minutes spent alive grants a level, which gives you significant advantages at maximum level. But beware: dying resets all progress. Survival ensures your hard-earned buffs.

You can check your active buffs at any time with Shift+B, or rebind this in your game options.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/975b7e48b094a83c4caa0aeca75e1b9e6c4f0ba3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/944ec0686f6aff39666e7251023021cf6d3e5e87.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/21ca4981351c2e11cbed8aa42086d264741d4261.png[/img]

Space is no longer just cold and empty – now it’s dangerous, too. Apex Survival adds environmental hazards like weather, radiation, and updated meteor storms that directly affect your survival and your builds.

[h3]Radiation[/h3]
Radiation introduces a persistent environmental threat that challenges players to build smart, stay shielded, and monitor their surroundings. 

[b]How Radiation Works:[/b]
[list]
[*] Radiation accumulates when near a source and decreases when no longer exposed.
[*] Safe spaces include sealed/pressurized environments, airtight cockpits, and cryopods.
[*] At values above 75 radiation, characters begin to take damage.
[*] At 100 radiation, damage increases significantly.
[*] The character’s radiation level is shown on the HUD.
[*] Note: Playing with Radiation requires Airtightness to also be enabled in the world’s settings.[/list][b]Solar Radiation[/b]
[list]
[*] The sun becomes a radiation emitter.
[*] This type of radiation is disabled by default. We view this radiation source as a “Hardcore” player’s setting. There is a dropdown in world settings which modifies the intensity of solar radiation, allowing it to be configured to the player’s desired level of difficulty.
[*] Exposure depends on whether the character is in direct sunlight.
[*] The atmosphere on Earth-Like, Alien, Titan, and Triton provide full protection.
[*] Mars and Pertam provide reduced protection, not enough to prevent exposure over time.
[*] The Moon and Europa offer no protection at all.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/cd78949621aabc272b05ed9b9851fa5c2f25a496.jpg[/img]
[b]Planetary Radiation[/b]
[list]
[*] Europa is now a source of radiation, exposing the character to higher amounts the closer they get to the surface.[/list][b]Weather-Based Radiation[/b]
[list]
[*] Certain weather conditions are now radioactive:
[*] Electric Storms on Pertam
[*] Toxic Haze on the Alien planet
[*] Rain has a cleansing effect, gradually reducing radiation buildup.[/list][b]Block-Based Radiation[/b]
[list]
[*] Damaged reactors now leak radiation. The closer the character is to the damaged reactor, the higher their exposure level.
[*] Unlike other sources, this radiation is powerful and can leak through grids and structures - there is no cover, and it can be very dangerous if left unattended.
[*] Reactor size directly impacts the amount of radiation gained per second, and also dictates the size of the contaminated area.
[*] Only Nuclear Reactor blocks are impacted, the Prototech Fusion Reactor does not emit radiation when damaged.[/list][b]Radiation Countermeasures[/b]
[list]
[*] A new consumable has been added: Anti-Radiation MedKit
[*] Grants 10 minutes of immunity from all radiation sources.
[*] Gradually clears accumulated radiation over 30 seconds.
[*] This item can not be crafted, and can only be looted from encounters and NPC storage.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/92429113fc6610f1e3d638625ff98a048eaeb6dc.jpg[/img]
[h3]Weather Hazards[/h3]
All weather effects have been updated with new values and improved visuals. Some extreme weather types are now directly hazardous to characters, dealing damage over time when exposed. Grids are not affected, and shelter will fully protect characters from these effects.
[list]
[*] Sandstorms can be encountered on Mars, Titan, Pertam, Earthlike and Alien planets.
[*] Hailstorms can be encountered on Mars, Titan, Triton, Earthlike and Alien planets.
[*] Caustic Rain and Toxic Haze can be encountered on the Alien Planet.
[*] Electric Storms can be encountered on Pertam.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/a264bda8db8dd2c493f3c1325c0945ffbfbce8a0.png[/img]
[h3]Meteors[/h3]
Meteors have been reworked to feel more natural and immersive. Meteors can still damage players and grids, they’re no longer a primary threat – instead, they bring excitement to otherwise quiet corners of the universe.
[list]
[*] Meteors no longer target grids directly. Instead, they spawn near the player and pass through the area, adding atmospheric flair rather than devastation.
[*] A new event system ensures that meteor showers don’t stack in multiplayer – no more getting hit repeatedly just because you’re near other players.
[*] Meteors no longer deform voxels or leave craters on impact.
[*] Planets like Earthlike and Alien have thick atmospheres that block meteors entirely, making them safe zones.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/dea6d00c4c2c4b1ef15df225d402d1d1c2687014.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/dd9a81878cae35f0d2f68c28011134e22ec3c6aa.png[/img]

Apex Survival brings a fresh batch of content to space with 30 brand-new Space Encounters. These new encounters offer a wide range of gameplay – from curious exploration opportunities and light storytelling to unexpected dangers that will challenge your survival instincts. All legacy encounters have been removed, ensuring every encounter you discover feels new and purpose-built for the current game experience.

These random Encounters remain a space-exclusive feature and spawn only at predefined locations determined by your world seed. The system itself hasn't changed, but to improve clarity, the world setting formerly known as “Encounter Density” has been renamed to “Random Encounter Density.” This setting still controls how frequently these encounters appear in your world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/846c00ce581a231f77b4185e4b66fe8604893b9b.png[/img]
[h3]Reorganized World Settings [/h3]
The world settings menu has been streamlined and reorganized into clear, intuitive categories. Settings are now grouped based on their function, making it easier to find and adjust the options that matter most for your gameplay style.

Additionally, tooltips for all world settings have been revised for clarity - giving you better insight into how each setting affects your survival experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/0e20148d920b8f4f31ef26c9f47bd869bc2498c2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/f823a027b41b11cdf6b77e85b496425ae3f6be2f.png[/img]

We’ve substantially increased the drop rates for all skins on Steam from Unknown Signals until September 22. Strong Unknown Signals, which have a chance to drop the rarest skins, are especially rewarding during this period. We’ve also reduced the cooldown between possible skin drops, so you’ll have more chances to earn cosmetic rewards as you play.

Happy hunting, Engineers! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/e390ba315f7a21d129c7ab1aaacc988eca953d33.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/7bc6219b6f8a183e58785d57a40ece04bc7f3bce.png[/img]

The next 208 update will bring a welcome focus on bug fixes and quality-of-life improvements. We’re also researching the much-requested joystick support, and we still have a few surprises up our sleeve.

Over the past updates, we've reworked nearly every aspect of PvE: Prototech, Factorum global encounters and planetary encounters in Contact, Cargo Ships and Unknown Signals in Fieldwork, and now Hazards and Space Encounters in Apex Survival. The last major piece of that PvE puzzle? Economy stations and missions in the 209 update. 

We can’t wait to show you what’s next.

notes.title: Space Engineers Apex Survival: Space Encounters Overhaul
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/36619713047eabe8a0f98261084e0ec22ff14f1f.jpg[/img]
Hello, Engineers! 

Do you think you’ve already seen everything the void has to offer?

In [b]Apex Survival [/b]update, space encounters are getting a complete overhaul. We’ve rebuilt them from the ground up using all the new blocks and features available today – plus a few debuting in this update, like actions triggered by an offensive AI controller.

Pirates lurking in the darkness, remnants of unlucky entrepreneurs, wreckage and salvage ripe for the taking, and engineers in need of a hand – you’ll find it all out there. Be prepared and stay sharp, because you won’t know exactly what you’re dealing with until you’re right in the middle of it.

You know what they say about gazing into the void...

notes.title: Welcome to Space Engineers Free Weekend!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/7ff05e4ed64179b41164fc3b19e7827e62d3df75.jpg[/img]
There’s no better time to jump into Space Engineers – the ultimate sandbox for building, exploring, and surviving in space. This Free Weekend is your ticket to a universe of creative possibilities!

Build ships, design bases, explore alien planets, or test the limits of your engineering imagination – solo or with friends. Space Engineers has been shaped by an amazing community for over a decade, and now’s your chance to be a part of it.

[h3]🛠️ Check out the Workshop:[/h3]
➡️ [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/244850/workshop/][b]https://steamcommunity.com/app/244850/workshop/[/b][/url]

Discover jaw-dropping space stations, ships, mechs, and other creations – plus thousands of mods, skins, and scripts for the Programmable Block. You can tweak your Space Engineers experience into your ultimate sandbox, powered by one of the most passionate modding communities in gaming.

[h3]💬 Join our Discord:[/h3]
➡️ [url=https://discord.gg/keenswh][b]https://discord.gg/keenswh[/b][/url]

Connect with fellow players, modders, and helpful veterans ready to answer your questions and get you started.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/8e170491ef687243e0c49032b9a4ca22dd1e8510.jpg[/img]
Hello, Engineers! 

We’re excited to announce the upcoming Apex Survival Update for Space Engineers, arriving this September!

Building on the solid PVE foundation laid by previous updates like Contact and Fieldwork, Apex Survival update introduces food, farming, environmental hazards, new Space Encounters, and much more - giving survival mode a whole new edge. 

Stay tuned for more details as we get closer to the release!

If you’ve ever been curious about building, exploring, and surviving in the ultimate sandbox, there’s no better time to jump into Space Engineers. Try out the full game, experiment with engineering and design, and see why the community has been building in space [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/244850/workshop/]for over a decade[/url].

Hello, Engineers! 

From [b]Thursday, August 28, 5 PM UTC[/b] to [b]Monday, September 1, 5 PM UTC[/b], you can play Space Engineers on Steam for free!

If you’ve ever been curious about building, exploring, and surviving in the ultimate sandbox, there’s no better time to jump into Space Engineers. Try out the full game, experiment with engineering and design, and see why the community has been building in space [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/244850/workshop/]for over a decade[/url].

Starting [b]August 28[/b], we’re once again substantially increasing the drop rates for all skins on Steam from Unknown Signals. Strong Unknown Signals, which have a chance to drop the rarest skins, are especially rewarding during this event.

We’ve also reduced the cooldown between possible skin drops, giving you more chances to collect cosmetic rewards while you play.

The Great Skin Hunt will run until [b]Monday, September 22[/b].

notes.title: Update 207 Sneak Peek: Environmental Hazards
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/98fa2075b0ea56931ca4b58ea4e95a950944dd4f.jpg[/img]
Hello, Engineers! 

The upcoming 1.207 update for Space Engineers brings many new gameplay elements to survival mode. One of our core goals is to change how players view their character. We want players to feel invested in their character’s well-being and continued survival. 

Alongside other new systems which support this goal, we’re introducing environmental hazards that directly threaten that renewed sense of care - putting your engineer in serious danger.

One of the first hazards you’re likely to encounter on your journey comes in the form of overhauled weather events. These have been adjusted both visually and functionally. Sandstorms are no longer a temporary visual backdrop – they’re a dynamic and dangerous situation that must be planned for, endured, and overcome. Grids may become safe havens as these storms batter and choke the region.

Surviving the storm is just the beginning, more dangers lurk just over the horizon.

notes.title: Space Engineers 2 Modding, Porting Guidelines
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/ed28549f61a7085dc9fc3a2f0abe9a48475cfbd6.png[/img]

Hello, Engineers! 

New major update for Space Engineers 2 has been released! 

With Vertical Slice 1.5, we’re introducing the first phase of modding support for Space Engineers 2. This includes the release of the [b]VRAGE3 Mod HUB[/b] (a tool for mod creation, management and publishing) and [b]VRAGE3 Mod Editor[/b] (a tool for creating mod content). These are the same tools our designers and artists use to build Space Engineers 2. 

You are now able to create, modify, and preview content with ease directly in the VRAGE3 engine using a visual, game-integrated workflow.
[list]
[*] [b]Full Info:[/b] [url=https://2.spaceengineersgame.com/space-engineers-2-alpha-vertical-slice-1-5-modding/]https://2.spaceengineersgame.com/space-engineers-2-alpha-vertical-slice-1-5-modding/[/url]
[*] [b]Modding Guides:[/b] [url=https://2.spaceengineersgame.com/modding-guides/]https://2.spaceengineersgame.com/modding-guides/[/url]
[*] [b]Play Space Engineers 2 on Steam: [/b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1133870/Space_Engineers_2/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1133870/Space_Engineers_2/[/url]
[*] [b]Run the VRAGE3 HUB/Editor[/b] from the Steam Library (Tools Section) - search for “Space Engineers 2 - ModSDK”
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/b43afbbb206fb589b74b87769fbcc359cd61dce9.gif[/img]

[h3]Porting Guidelines Between SE1 and SE2[/h3]

With the release of modding support for Space Engineers 2, we want to clarify our stance on straight porting blocks between Space Engineers 1 and Space Engineers 2. Porting vanilla blocks from SE1 to SE2 is allowed. However, porting DLC content from SE1 to SE2 is not, and porting any SE2 content back to SE1 is also not allowed.
That said, this applies strictly to direct block ports. If you're creating your own blocks from scratch, inspired by designs from Space Engineers (including DLCs), that's totally fine – a pipe is a pipe is a pipe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/45f29f09da0f2bc46d71160632c14b821f5d744e.jpg[/img]
[h3]Celebratory Sale[/h3]

This update marks a major milestone for our incredible modding community, a true cornerstone of Space Engineers. Their creativity, innovation, and dedication have helped shape the game in extraordinary ways, and we believe that’s something worth celebrating.

We’re deeply grateful for the passion and support of our players whether you’ve been with us since the beginning or just joined the journey.

To welcome new engineers and continue growing the community, we’re offering a [b]20% discount until July 1st[/b]. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1133870/Space_Engineers_2/]Jump in now[/url] and help shape the next chapter of Space Engineers 2.

notes.title: Keen Software House Dev Diary: June 12, 2025
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/454fdfb31d324186a349e9d788c28afe3c3f46f1.jpg[/img]

[h3]Keen Software House Annual Meetup[/h3]
Like many studios, we went remote during the COVID pandemic. What started as a necessity became a strength - we discovered that fully remote development works. Since then, we’ve welcomed more and more talented, creative engineers, artists, designers, programmers and dreamers from all over the world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/609d023d6ffb9d3d9e8951330d816e399b38a4df.jpg[/img]

But once a year, we all come together in person at our HQ in the Oranžerie. It’s a tradition that’s become a vital part of our culture - a chance to reconnect, reflect, and recharge. No matter how many virtual meetings we have, nothing beats seeing your team face-to-face. Every meetup is a breath of fresh air, reminding us that this isn’t just a job - it’s a shared journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/58eee1615cffbc41c380a08bd4bcc62a9471d3dc.jpg[/img]
Over the years, we’ve grown not just in size and experience, but in connection. What started as colleagues working on a game has become something deeper: a global team of friends, united by a shared love for games, creativity, and of course - Space Engineers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/9dec6b62a2e66d75c1c495e54ddde7985441418d.jpg[/img]

During the meetup, the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1133870/Space_Engineers_2/]Space Engineers 2[/url] team surprised us with screenshots from our latest internal build - they were jaw dropping and I simply have to share them with you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/4edeca10e3fcac75d5ed39260a63a7c144a38c82.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/6d3acaf55df4988bcca113f91e6d3654a5351708.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/6decc36a437514d9ab964e115c03e1e29d3db4d0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/2c8fd084f94be4575b9b80eff58a9c72c4591595.jpg[/img]
As the meetup came to an end, no one was in a hurry to leave. After a few days of talking, planning, laughing, and just being together, it was hard to say goodbye. We're already looking forward to the next one – and to everything we'll build together in the year ahead.

notes.title: Space Engineers: Fieldwork Live Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/55ab39f99b145272f8d3ec2e5c255de51653ce10.jpg[/img]
Hello, Engineers!

The [url=https://www.spaceengineersgame.com/space-engineers-fieldwork-live-now/][b]Fieldwork Update[/b][/url] is here! We’ve improved PvE Encounters, including a full rework of Cargo Ship and Unknown Signal encounters. This update also adds the new Prototech Fusion Reactor, a Small Oxygen Tank, and a Large Grid Small Connector - along with a wide range of quality of life fixes and improvements.

The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3601770/Space_Engineers__Fieldwork_Pack/][b]Fieldwork Pack[/b][/url] includes new decorative blocks with visuals ideal for building secret bunkers, mad scientist labs, mobile research outposts, and more. Perfect for engineers working off the grid.
[list]
[*]Full Blog Post: [url=https://www.spaceengineersgame.com/space-engineers-fieldwork-live-now/]https://www.spaceengineersgame.com/space-engineers-fieldwork-live-now/[/url]
[*]Encounters Modding Guide: [url=https://www.spaceengineersgame.com/modding-guides/encounter-modding-guide]https://www.spaceengineersgame.com/modding-guides/encounter-modding-guide[/url][/list]
[previewyoutube=Jg2Sg_VKpCU;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/d7552ff0e438ce986f19fb67ed3aa07675e608dc.png[/img]

All the Cargo Ship encounters and all Unknown Signals have been overhauled. You do not need to start a new world to experience them.

[h3]Cargo Ships Overhaul[/h3]
NPC Cargo Ships have been completely revamped and updated for a fresh new experience. These grids now make use of modern weapon systems, AI blocks, and communicate using Broadcast Controllers. They’re designed to sit between the simpler Unknown Signal encounters and the more dangerous Factorum threats - offering a mid-tier challenge and rewards.

The factions are randomly generated when you create a world. These include traders, builders, miners, military groups, pirate factions, and two special global factions: The Factorum and Unknown. This system hasn’t changed in this update - but the ships they use have. Cargo ships now use the same faction-based system and colors. This means ships will inherit the colors of the faction they belong to, adding more visual variety. Pirate factions are an exception - instead of their usual black color, they now use random paint schemes to reflect their scavenger nature, suggesting they steal parts and ships from other factions rather than build their own.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/987e5e78500aa3086aceeb3ca6148dd09cc15b49.gif[/img]

Cargo ships can now call for reinforcements via their antennas if your reputation with that faction is negative. Some ships may appear lightly defended at first, but once you go hostile, they’ll dispatch additional drones to respond. Each faction type has individual behaviors and 2 to 4 unique drone variants, adding more tactical depth and variety to these encounters.
[list]
[*] [b]Trade Factions:[/b] Least hostile. Tend to flee on sight. Lightly armed.
[*] [b]Mining Factions:[/b] Tolerate nearby players but may become hostile if approached. Often flee rather than fight.
[*] [b]Builder Factions:[/b] Behave similarly to mining factions.
[*] [b]Military Factions:[/b] Do not like being approached. Will pursue players who get too close.
[*] [b]Pirate Factions:[/b] Hostile on sight. Will engage whenever possible. Some larger ships can launch salvage-seeking drones.
[*] [b]Unknown Faction:[/b] Rare and unique spawns.[/list]
[h3]Unknown Signals Overhaul[/h3]
New grids for all Unknown Signals. Like Cargo Ships, these grids now take advantage of modern blocks and we also made adjustments to their loot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/47e73e4afaef018dec4d842811a662f14b5a2cf3.gif[/img]

[h3]Strong Unknown Signals Overhaul[/h3]
Strong Unknown Signals are now composed entirely of Large Grid blocks. Their location is visible to all players on the server, and they have a chance to contain high-end loot and salvage - making them valuable targets worth cooperating to take down... or competing over.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/4d37936435bf6c5fa84ce4c7555e52f244da36fa.gif[/img]

[h3]Improvements to Planetary Encounter Spawning[/h3]
We’ve made improvements to the spawn system for Planetary Encounters which should make these encounters spawn more reliably and frequently, ensuring players regularly have content to explore on the surface of planets.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/f823a027b41b11cdf6b77e85b496425ae3f6be2f.png[/img]

Starting today and running through May 30, we’ve substantially increased the drop rates for all skins on Steam from Unknown Signals. Strong Unknown Signals, which have a chance to drop the rarest skins, are especially rewarding during this period. We’ve also reduced the cooldown between possible skin drops, so you’ll have more chances to earn cosmetic rewards as you play.

Happy hunting, Engineers! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/16b7b3f50f9923278b390cb0fe9c1c89d921c41d.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/7bc6219b6f8a183e58785d57a40ece04bc7f3bce.png[/img]

Survival Mode. We’re expanding the survival experience with new gameplay systems in our next update. Environmental hazards will affect how you explore and build, while managing food supplies and maintaining farm plots will become key to staying alive in the frontier of space.

All of these features will be optional and configurable when creating your world, so you can tailor survival to fit your playstyle - whether you're looking for a hardcore challenge or a more relaxed experience. We’re looking forward to sharing more soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/2e30fb2b88ebdcf65bcaf410aa68befd338fa95a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/904a92e1962c963bcd9b3fc08911c2d900b76198.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/062e0059e5cf82283245efb09c809ddabb81cacc.png[/img]

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
[tr]
	[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/4a14ad6be17c6c0fe654d63997addb8e20fa0d4a.gif[/img][/td]
	[td][b]Prototech Fusion Reactor[/b] (1 block, L grid) - A highly efficient power generator which utilizes hydrogen as a fuel source. It can provide large amounts of power to grids. Challenge the Factorum to obtain one for yourself![/td]
[/tr]

[tr]
	[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/cae3bb0aa09a684bffc2797865ef0558713b1de5.gif[/img][/td]
	[td][b]Small Oxygen Tank[/b] (1 block, S grid) - A compact oxygen tank perfect for exploring low oxygen environments.[/td]
[/tr]

[tr]
	[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/bd8411bc543ebcf49fea27157eefeb47fec092c1.gif[/img][/td]
	[td][b]Large Grid Small Connector[/b] (1 block, L grid) - This block serves as an adapter which allows Small Grids utilizing the Small Connector to dock directly to Large Grids.[/td]
[/tr]

[tr]
	[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/3e710ac7fdc72979e8e1719088ff475b7f778a07.gif[/img][/td]
	[td][b]Refill Station[/b] (2 blocks, L grid + 1 block, S grid) - This block allows engineers to quickly refill their suit’s oxygen, hydrogen, and energy. Any player can refill from these stations, regardless of faction standing or ownership.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/93259806ee7b899d6f04aa32a9ba8996b8445d8a.png[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3066290/Space_Engineers__Contact_Pack/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/3b2b2ba4e493ac3e4c2a40defa95735c7018f375.png[/img][/url]

We are always looking for ways to improve, and that includes adding value to prior releases. During this update, we are adding new content to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3066290/Space_Engineers__Contact_Pack/][b]Contact Pack[/b][/url]. 

Those who already own Contact Pack will get this content for free, as part of the update.

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
[tr]
	[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/08d0900fbfe99593d5e3c1e3fd37e5a8496e1082.gif[/img][/td]
	[td][b]Additional Bridge Blocks[/b] (7 blocks, L grid) - Additional blocks featuring reinforced windows, designed to be combined into the ideal bridge for a large grid ship.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/751ee29f7c460d0fa6f55d98d62ff9b7a892b0e9.png[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3601770/Space_Engineers__Fieldwork_Pack/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/e196bd1d373032000171ccfa3d0dacf962b54a92.png[/img][/url]

Similar to our previous major releases, we hope you will take this opportunity to support the continued development of Space Engineers. This DLC pack consists of cosmetic items that enrich your game visually. None of the features in this package provide any advantage to players who purchase this DLC. 

The price of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3601770/Space_Engineers__Fieldwork_Pack/][b]Fieldwork Pack[/b][/url] is $4.99 USD or your regional equivalent. Show your continued support for Space Engineers and check out the Fieldwork Pack.

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]

	[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/4c3101557d9749321c04fd71e2ba896600229601.gif[/img][/td]

[/tr]

[tr]
	[td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/4d8f8ec70498d69f4661dcce204a815a2652ae70.gif[/img][/td]

notes.title: Space Engineers: Fieldwork Launching April 28
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/410bb75a38b73bdf43dfa2de2d2bdf99411d2a22.jpg[/img]
[h3]Join us this Monday for the Space Engineers: Fieldwork Update release![/h3]

[h3]📅 Monday, April 28th, 5 PM UTC[/h3]

[b]Release Livestream:[/b]
🛰️ Twitch: [url=https://twitch.tv/keencommunitynetwork]https://twitch.tv/keencommunitynetwork[/url]
🛰️ YouTube: [url=https://youtube.com/user/SpaceEngineersGame]https://youtube.com/user/SpaceEngineersGame[/url]

[previewyoutube=4z-ay2SRkvM;full][/previewyoutube]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/f823a027b41b11cdf6b77e85b496425ae3f6be2f.png[/img]

Starting with Fieldwork release and running through May 30, we’ve substantially increased the drop rates on Steam for all skins from Unknown Signals. 

Strong Unknown Signals, which have a chance to drop the rarest skins, are especially rewarding during this period. We’ve also reduced the cooldown between possible skin drops, so you’ll have more chances to earn cosmetic rewards as you play.

Happy hunting, Engineers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/1b77d49f66c86ff0d8329ab833a5adf178c17069.png[/img]

notes.title: Space Engineers: Fieldwork Is Closing In!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/52c69c07b587244b4e94794f03bd7feaf42b2bb2.jpg[/img]
Hello, Engineers!

We’re excited to announce the upcoming update for Space Engineers: [b]Fieldwork[/b]!

This update brings improved PvE encounters - including a full rework of Cargo Ship and Unknown Signal encounters. Cargo ships are designed to sit between the simpler Unknown Signal encounters and the more dangerous end-game Factorum threats - offering a mid-tier challenge and rewards.

The update also introduces the much-requested Small Oxygen Tank, a Large Grid Small Connector, and a new Prototech Fusion Reactor waiting to be liberated from the Factorum. And that's not all - expect a wide range of quality-of-life improvements. Stay tuned for more details as we get closer to release!

notes.title: Community Spotlight 🧐 March 2025
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3448506763][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/2d3354621fc0967418b2dab4bd6e0a870b9f13fc.jpg[/img][/url]

Our favorite pastime is browsing through the workshop - we are in love with all the creations our players are constantly sharing. 💫

We can't wait every month to spotlight mods and blueprints that catch our eye and have the potential to make your time in Space Engineers more interesting and unique. 

Here is our spotlight for the month of March! 🤩

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
[tr]
	[td][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3452081513][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/af9639a96445c8a24b35f07b3c1e69ae495fe5ad.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
	[td][h3][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3452081513]Advanced Pulley Systems by TwitchingPsycho & Daniel "Nero" Drake[/url][/h3]
This mod was created as collaboration between TwitchingPsycho and Daniel "Nero" Drake

This mod contains 3 piston/pulley.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3437815208][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/c4ae6b0601893b976e77ab966316f5ad0a8e30af.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
	[td][h3][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3437815208]AQD - Airlock Connectors by enenra[/url][/h3]
This mod adds airlock connectors in two sizes to the game. 

Airlock connectors can be used to create airtight connections between grids without using merge blocks. They can only be connected to other airlock connectors of the same type.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3440043209][img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/18682083340720818/055962985A008D894C0D87C8368E0616A615D250/[/img][/url][/td]
	[td][h3][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3440043209]GFA - Imperial Construction by enenra[/url][/h3]
This mod adds various blocks, both decorative and functional, to the game. 

The blocks are based off of designs used by the Empire in the Star Wars original trilogy and other media set in that timeframe.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3450960545][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/310c8af3fadbe9293086aae5b9c1a6da355630b4.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
	[td][h3][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3450960545]Federal Industrial - Vacuum Balloons by Frosty[/url][/h3]
Float like a balloon, soar like an airship! Vacuum Balloons provide lift using pure buoyancy, letting your ships rise effortlessly without thrusters or fuel. 

Instead of burning propellant, these balloons naturally provide lift, keeping you afloat in planetary atmospheres.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3433431569][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/8531b97ecc9943370aa767cdd9a1887f1b10890c.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
	[td][h3][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3433431569]Satisfactory Scenario by KevMeUp[/url][/h3]
A Satisfactory Scenario in Space Engineers. You start on the Alien Planet with The Hub, Mk1 Mining Unit and the Space Elevator built (Yes, it really works). 

You can harvest Biomass, wire your builds, setup long conveyor belts (Pipelines), Make a Tractor or Drone, make a Power Plant, Factories, and earn rewards for sending things into the Awesome Sink.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3437940110][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/4fbbd41cd868826a342a68862c60984fe08dee5d.jpg[/img][/url][/td]

notes.title: Community Spotlight 🧐 February 2025
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3426803781][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/316cc16caf0a0fc2fba05ff50a9cd79b1faa47c6.jpg[/img][/url]

Our favorite pastime is browsing through the workshop - we are in love with all the creations our players are constantly sharing. 💫

We can't wait every month to spotlight mods and blueprints that catch our eye and have the potential to make your time in Space Engineers more interesting and unique. 

Here is our spotlight for the month of February! 🤩

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
[tr]
	[td][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3420134294][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/a1210b9fbea0776ab4f83a4eb507a5694c13eef7.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
	[td][h3][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3420134294]Thermal Dynamics by Gauge[/url][/h3]
This was a project i have been working on for 2 years. Fully simulated heat transfer with environmental interactions.

I recommend creating a fresh world and adding grids to it. I DO NOT recommend you add it to a world you care about. At least not until you know how it works.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3434327130][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/e00859321f3497c1e9e10f07db89aa35f1afccf2.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
	[td][h3][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3434327130]APOCRYPHA - Abyssal Systems by STRATDEV[/url][/h3]
Introducing APOCRYPHA - Abyssal Systems, a moderately sized yet ever-expanding collection of voidborne weaponry aimed at providing unique ordnance to split the Void in two.

Inspired by the famed EVE Online [as most of my work is], this mod aims to soon encompass many of the unique capabilities and weaponry that EVE itself is so famous for.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3420086843][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/f0b2c877acb7a1df1457626f06419f5988641ef4.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
	[td][h3][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3420086843]Rescue of Echo Company - Sandbox Story Scenario[/url][/h3]
Sent by the Ronin Empire, your mission is simple: rescue Echo Company, a missing military science team whose fate has become a chilling enigma. 

As the team sent to make a rescue attempt, you've been given a basic frigate with little defense, a drop ship to get down to planets, and a rover for some basic travel.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3429100096][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/1007b573be4b74ba3eaf4c35565e090b4e7a4536.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
	[td][h3][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3429100096]Udarvis System - Real Solar Systems Proxy Pack by sam[/url][/h3]
Welcome to the Real Solar Systems Proxy World! 

All Planets are exported in 4096x2048.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3429972390][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/618d9c1c470efeeee39774604bdc4609cefe37b2.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
	[td][h3][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3429972390]MuraCore System by Soviet Bunny[/url][/h3]
Uncharted Sector 4361B - MuraCore System exist a large black hole that has devoured all the planets and stars in its cluster but for some anomalous reason decided to keep one star anchored. 

Around that lone survivor exist several planets, some earth-like and others completely alien.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3415239154][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/8fb12373ba5b85b0494cf3deea41345daa34e9f2.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
	[td][h3][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3415239154]ABYSSAL - Sublight Systems by Opium Hierophant[/url][/h3]
Introducing ABYSSAL - Sublight Systems, a small but expanding collection of thrusters aimed at providing an attractive yet accessible manner of conventional propulsion.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3078500424][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/5512b6d8ff4bd31722062d07e721482824a8a4bc.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
	[td][h3][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3078500424]Consolidation Propulsions by Foltast[/url][/h3]
The new major update for Consolidation Propulsions is out! 

Meet the new additions to Stribog series and completely new set of hybrid thrusters - Aeolus![/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3420330166][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/028da1e109583e1189bf77fa2c5fb93bb55d6df3.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
	[td][h3][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3420330166]Ares at War BETA by CaptainArthur[/url][/h3]
This is the latest version of Ares at War.

Please report bugs or feedback. That is the point of this Beta. Thanks![/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3416343059][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/2868ffa64ce4afd754f6319aed10da99dbe4b19f.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
	[td][h3][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3416343059]STL Shop by Stalkron[/url][/h3]
Player-to-player trading[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3429727410][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/2f28d0250a4021947f42d54488b6f4d76b51e8d3.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
	[td][h3][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3429727410]IBT Plane Fuel Tank & Conveyors by ibterrer [UA][/url][/h3]
Adds 4 hydrogen tanks with a capacity of 300,000 liters and a semi-block tank of 25,000 liters, as well as small conveyors with a diameter of 25 cm.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3427063727][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/6086c69c8458b7c3ed865dbeb73e11e833dbc8a2.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
	[td][h3][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3427063727]KWP Armors and Structures by Khjin[/url][/h3]
This mod pack will contain my current and future armor, structure, and occasional niche block updates related to structural building.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3410224718][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/d127aef74c6c37bb7cf121f7f81b8f0084f704c9.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
	[td][h3][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3410224718]Low-Tech Space Traffic by AnUnscrupulousFerret[/url][/h3]
Low-Tech Space Traffic adds a small variety of hydrogen-powered ships to supplement vanilla cargo ship traffic.

The "Space Denizens" civilian faction is included for generic versions of trade ships and other unusual spacecraft. Some ships are owned by this faction, and some belong to default economy factions.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3417101164][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/8cc935f43e69a4d19f61304348f0dba47cd100b5.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
	[td][h3][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3417101164]Cado's Space Elevator[/url][/h3]
 Automated elevator capable of bringing into orbit ships of mass up to around 3 000 000 kg. 

Wheels only, includes pillar constructor sitting at the top.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3430991891][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/ef1b742f0c53bd70953c3f32c3a66af11d2d27e9.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
	[td][h3][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3430991891]Self Building Wheel Powered Space Elevator by Mattzuton[/url][/h3]
Space elevator base and Space Elevator (wheel powered), Self Building Mechanism

Once finished, a projector will project the space station, which you will have to weld yourself.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3425221932][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/783b8f02a00c4feecbf878f08e74a41083c3c43c.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
	[td][h3][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3425221932]Handcrank Electrical Power Generator by Luca[/url][/h3]
Move or rotate the lever by hand to generate power

Connect things to the grid to recharge them![/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[h3]February Creator Spotlights[/h3]
We also have a [url=https://www.spaceengineersgame.com/category/community/]Creator Spotlight[/url] series of articles on our [url=https://www.spaceengineersgame.com/community-hub/]Community Hub![/url]

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]

	[td][url=https://www.spaceengineersgame.com/creator-spotlight-amai/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/253d607b8b05fd4bc0c679cad2dbf1436b1c32ea.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
	[td][h3][url=https://www.spaceengineersgame.com/creator-spotlight-amai/]Creator Spotlight: Amai Dolce[/url][/h3]
“When it comes to building things, that first spark of creativity will become the most important building block of your future."[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td][url=https://www.spaceengineersgame.com/creator-spotlight-dread-mechanic/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/96a40e7722c6ced7c8197c18f27b4869e431274f.jpg[/img][/url][/td]

notes.title: Community Spotlight 🧐 January 2025
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3413097355][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/0e3a32588bd7fbf96735c6ea2197109c3e7a4272.jpg[/img][/url]

Our favorite pastime is browsing through the workshop - we are in love with all the creations our players are constantly sharing. 💫

We can't wait every month to spotlight mods and blueprints that catch our eye and have the potential to make your time in Space Engineers more interesting and unique. 

Here is our spotlight for the month of January! 🤩

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
[tr]
	[td][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3411507973][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/42174c74b4dfc2c12f0d2fd6e0b0f51db3477b8a.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
	[td][h3][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3411507973]Mother OS by Agentluke[/url][/h3]
Mother is a general purpose operating system for Space Engineers grids, available as an in-game script. 

It exposes an intuitive command line interface (CLI), flexible flight control & planning, and an intergrid communication system to massively expand what you can do with your grid(s).[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3414502216][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/2e4288cb7ff7a159fcd457bc651f7ac7d07f4ed9.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
	[td][h3][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3414502216]Aliens SE by shadow trace[/url][/h3]
After awakening from your cryo chamber, you discover that you’ve crashed on an unknown planet.
There is nothing here but death. But you’re not alone—you are being hunted. Your only chance of survival is to escape this hellhole. Follow the clues, scavenge what you can from lockers and containers, and find a way off the planet.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3398938813][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/5bcb4992a8bc4205f9c964b78966185e08134356.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
	[td][h3][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3398938813]Sorkuta - The Lost Radioactive City by huesaturation[/url][/h3]
You are a space app pilot, and what seemed like an ordinary day turns into a nightmare when a horde of hostile drones begins to chase and attack you. After traveling thousands of miles on the run, with almost no oxygen and nothing left to lose, you receive an unexpected distress call that takes you to an abandoned radioactive city, full of mysteries and conspiracies, on a nearby planet.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td][previewyoutube=oSCmtmSOVkc;full][/previewyoutube][/td]
	[td][h3][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3399759385]Light Casts Shadow by Sarekh[/url][/h3]
A story-driven scenario for single and multiplayer.

Exactly 172 years ago, the Empire lost contact with the newly established colony of Volentia. Before this, reports of a spreading illness on the colony’s core world had been received via the then-unreliable interstellar communication systems. Now, the Royal Research Institute has assembled experts from several High Houses for an expedition.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3412657089][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/1c3bf85c53cd3c26284cd349b6e5158d022937b7.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
	[td][h3][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3412657089]OmniCorp - The OmniArc Project: Adv Tools by Raidfire[/url][/h3]
OmniCorp's OmniArc Project is the ultimate evolution of engineering tools, designed for the most advanced and demanding operations in the galaxy. 

Built for endgame content, the OmniArc tools push the limits of technology and power. [/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
	[td][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3406372006][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/27dcc856679c8f55bc7add151fce014cf42c8277.jpg[/img][/url][/td]
	[td][h3][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3406372006]Legion Encounters-MES by wikedsirnate[/url][/h3]
The Legion is a dedicated para-military organization and a major galactic power. It is one of the largest and strongest standing private military corporations and boasts a dedicated naval force as well as a massive ground army. While not openly hostile, they see any attempt to interfere with their operations as an act of aggression and will respond with lethal force.[/td]

notes.title: Space Engineers 2 Alpha has officially launched on Steam Early Access!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354154/979129f702b5b3b9e6eba972665e07a163e38bef.png[/img]

Hello, Engineers!

The day has come - Space Engineers 2 Alpha has officially launched on Steam Early Access! 

After months of anticipation and hard work, we’re excited to take this first step together. The thrilling journey of Space Engineers 2 starts now, and we invite you all to be part of it. The release of the Alpha and Vertical Slice1: Creative Mode is just the beginning - there’s so much more ahead!
[list]
[*] [b]Full Blog Post:[/b] [url=https://2.spaceengineersgame.com/space-engineers-2-alpha-early-access-release/]https://2.spaceengineersgame.com/space-engineers-2-alpha-early-access-release/[/url]
[*] [b]Roadmap:[/b] [url=https://2.spaceengineersgame.com/roadmap-2/]https://2.spaceengineersgame.com/roadmap-2/[/url]
[*] [b]Grid Exporter Tool Guide:[/b] [url=https://2.spaceengineersgame.com/experienced-players/grid-exporter/]https://2.spaceengineersgame.com/experienced-players/grid-exporter/[/url]
[*] [b]Connect:[/b] [url=https://www.keenswh.com/connect/]https://www.keenswh.com/connect/[/url]
[/list]
We’re taking a unique approach to developing Space Engineers 2 with our [b]Vertical Slice[/b] strategy. A Vertical Slice is a fully playable portion of the game that showcases specific core features and improvements implemented at production quality. It serves as a milestone in the game’s development, allowing us to focus on delivering polished gameplay in stages while more features are added in subsequent slices.

You have now access to VS1: Creative Mode. Additional Vertical Slices will follow in the months after, each expanding the game's features and content. This development process will continue over the next few years until we achieve our full vision for Space Engineers 2.

[previewyoutube=yCLtHwfH0ws;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Forging the Future Together[/h2]

But first let’s talk openly and honestly about the Space Engineers 2 Alpha - the word [b]“Alpha”[/b] is really important. Releasing Space Engineers 2 in such an early stage of development isn’t just a milestone for us; it’s a deliberate choice. It reflects our commitment to transparency, collaboration, and building something incredible together with our players.

We’re just as excited about Space Engineers 2 as you are. We couldn’t wait for you to get your hands on it and see what [b]amazing creations you’ll dream up[/b] within this new chapter of the Space Engineers universe. Your creativity inspires us, and we know the game will truly shine as you begin to explore, experiment, and push its boundaries.

We’ve seen firsthand the power of a great symbiosis with our community. Space Engineers 1 was shaped, refined, and elevated by your ideas, feedback, and passion. [b]You push us to try harder, aim higher, and get further.[/b] Without your voices, Space Engineers would have been a much different game. [b]That same spirit is what drives us today.[/b]

An early release like this brings [b]enormous advantages[/b] - not just for us, but for you. We get the opportunity to test ideas, uncover hidden challenges, and innovate beyond our limits. You get to experience and shape the development firsthand, influence its direction, and witness the evolution of the game from the ground up.

That said, let’s be honest. [b]If you’re not ready for an unpolished experience[/b], this may not be the right time to jump in. If you prefer to “plug in and play,” [b]we encourage you to[/b] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1133870/Space_Engineers_2/]wishlist[/url], sign up for our [url=https://www.keenswh.com/newsletter]newsletter[/url], [url=https://www.keenswh.com/connect/]follow the development[/url], and wait for future updates when the game becomes more feature-complete. As a reminder, here’s the [url=https://2.spaceengineersgame.com/roadmap-2#current][b]Roadmap[/b][/url], so you can see where we’re headed and decide the best time to hop on this journey.

However, if you’re excited about shaping the future of Space Engineers 2 with us - [url=https://2.spaceengineersgame.com/store/]visit our Store[/url], our [url=https://support.keenswh.com/spaceengineers2/pc]Support Portal[/url] and get involved!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354154/fbb9d1f96836f3a26d1425aead018a6b0bfe833a.png[/img]
[h2]How to share your feedback?[/h2]

The best way to provide your feedback is through our [url=https://support.keenswh.com/spaceengineers2/pc][b]Support Portal[/b][/url]. You can always find a direct link to the support portal from within the game - just press F1 to access the help screen! 

This platform is your direct line to the developers and the Space Engineers community. Here, you can:
[list]
[*] Create a Bugreport
[*] Create a ticket with your Feedback/Idea
[*] [url=https://support.keenswh.com/spaceengineers2/pc/topics/all/status/all/category/all/sort/popular/page/1]Vote[/url] on other ideas or bug reports
[*] Comment and Interact with fellow players
[*] Suggest solutions and provide valuable feedback to help shape the future of Space Engineers 2
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354154/51bcbbbac3e00a33912ec58d7a3201bbe4697f17.jpg[/img]
[h2]Vertical Slice 1: Creative Mod - Features[/h2]
You have now access to VS1: Creative Mode, our first vertical slice, featuring:
[list]
[*] [b]New VRAGE3 engine[/b] brings better performance and future optimization potential
[*] [b]new 25cm unified grid system[/b] (no more small vs. large grids!)
[*] [b]new blueprint building[/b] (snap to grid, partial copy/paste, assign to toolbar)
[*] [b]grid undo/redo[/b]
[*] [b]enhanced creative mode [/b]with powerful building tools (new voxel hand, symmetry tools, line/plane building)
[*] [b]grid speeds up to ~300 m/s [/b]
[*] [b]safe speed [/b]system preventing damage under 20 m/s
[*] [b]new magboots [/b]with camera stabilization
[*] [b]new physics and dynamic fractures and debris[/b] for more realistic destruction
[*] [b]visual revolution[/b] thanks to ray tracing, global illumination, tessellated terrain, parallax mapping, sleek armor edges, and enhanced lighting
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1133870/Space_Engineers_2/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/dc4ad30516b15981807197baf0c14336d61bfbcb.jpg[/img]
[h2]Pioneer Edition[/h2]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/48063/Space_Engineers_2_Pioneer_Edition_Bundle/]Pioneer Edition Bundle[/url] includes the base game, soundtrack, and exclusive behind-the-scenes development materials (from 2022 to 2024). As development continues, [b]we will keep adding new content[/b] and updates.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/48063/Space_Engineers_2_Pioneer_Edition_Bundle/

For Space Engineers 2's soundtrack and in-game music, we wanted to capture the story of people who carried their ancestral heritage across 10,000 light-years to The Amalgest System. We drew inspiration from various ethnic styles: the soul-stirring melodies of Eastern Europe, the mystical sounds of Arabia, the intricate patterns of Indian music, and the primal rhythms of Northern European tribes.

To bring this vision to life, we turned to Karel Antonin, who has been composing and leading music production for our games for almost 15 years, from Miner Wars through Space Engineers and Medieval Engineers. Under Karel's direction, each piece of music became a bridge between Earth's ancient cultures and humanity's far future, blending traditional instruments with modern synthesizers to show how our musical heritage might evolve across millennia. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354154/720762d22aaa8d8ed0239692f56d89e4e7e13e4c.jpg[/img]

Working with talented musicians and a full orchestra, Karel composed music that feels both ancient and futuristic, where you might hear folk melodies transformed through electronic textures while still maintaining their emotional core. This vision continues the musical journey we began together all those years ago, growing and evolving with each game we create.

[h3]Soundtrack Recording[/h3]

What happens when you put together over 80 amazing players and record the score live?
It was an amazing day from start to finish, filled with "hard fun", notes & liters of coffee. Check it out: 

[previewyoutube=dhE-AUceu3I;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/3f9b7cf028080f55fdac38db0a32049971b9b8d0.jpg[/img]

We’re hard at work on the next Space Engineers update!

Alongside the NPC Cargo Ship overhauls we shared with you last month, there are a number of very exciting blocks and features headed your way. This month we’ll be showcasing one of the more unique items on the list, coming as part of the free portion of the 1.206 update - a large grid variant of the Small Inset Connector.

This block serves as an adapter which allows small grids equipped with the Small Connector to directly connect to large grids, vastly improving the docking experience for grids which utilize them.

notes.title: Space Engineers 2: Alpha Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/64753e0ef306c7e264a7d7a78ddf3e0df53867a5.jpg[/img]
Engineers, prepare for liftoff! Today marks a monumental leap in the Space Engineers saga. 

We are thrilled to announce [url=https://2.spaceengineersgame.com/][b]Space Engineers 2[/b][/url], the revolutionary next chapter in space simulation gaming. This isn't just an update—it's a complete reimagining of the space engineering experience, built on new foundations to push the boundaries of what's possible in a sandbox universe.

[previewyoutube=Qw-I-uzT5KY;full][/previewyoutube]

Mark your calendars: The Space Engineers 2 alpha will launch on January 27, 2025. But you don't have to wait until then to join our journey, [url=https://2.spaceengineersgame.com/store/]pre-orders are available now[/url] on our website.

You can pre-order either the Base Game or the Pioneer Edition, which includes the game's soundtrack and behind-the-scenes development materials.

On January 27, you'll have access to [b]VS1: Creative Mode[/b], our first vertical slice, featuring:
[list]
[*] [b]new 25cm unified grid system[/b] (no more small vs. large grids!)
[*][b] new blueprint building[/b] (snap to grid, partial copy/paste, assign to toolbar)
[*] [b]grid undo/redo[/b]
[*] [b]enhanced creative mode with powerful building tool[/b]s (new voxel hand, symmetry tools, line/plane building)
[*] [b]grid speeds up to ~300 m/s [/b]
[*] [b]safe speed system[/b] preventing damage under 20 m/s
[*] [b]new magboots[/b] with camera stabilization
[*] [b]new physics and dynamic fractures[/b] and debris for more realistic destruction
[*] visual revolution thanks to [b]ray tracing, global illumination, tessellated terrain, parallax mapping, sleek armor edges, and enhanced lighting[/b]
[*] [b]New VRAGE3[/b] engine brings better performance and future optimization potential
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/7838c5531cdb7adebcdc28e42b80e8aa38e5a399.jpg[/img]
Additional Vertical Slices will follow in the months after, each expanding the game's features and content. This development process will continue over the next few years until we achieve our full vision for Space Engineers 2.

We're taking a unique approach with our Vertical Slice strategy, allowing us to perfect core features before moving to the next set. By sharing early access and development insights, we can incorporate valuable community feedback along the way. We're committed to delivering a polished and playable experience with each Vertical Slice, unlocking new possibilities as we progress. Our focus is on providing you with meaningful content, not unfinished prototypes. 

For full information/blog post, continue here: [url=https://2.spaceengineersgame.com/space-engineers-2-alpha-revealed/]https://2.spaceengineersgame.com/space-engineers-2-alpha-revealed/
[/url]
[url=https://2.spaceengineersgame.com/roadmap-2#current][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/b721f1c19046d034174b773f215804fb201797e0.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Commitment to Space Engineers 1[/h1]

Our dedication to Space Engineers 1 remains as strong as ever. 

For over 11 years, we've consistently delivered free updates, enhancing the game experience for our community. We're continuing active development - while the 1.205 Contact Update has just been released, the design team is already hard at work on the next update. 

In 1.206, we're planning to introduce more PvE content and refresh some of the existing Cargo Ships.

[previewyoutube=J6qJHR8OJhQ;full][/previewyoutube]
Alongside the NPC Cargo Ship overhauls, there are a number of very exciting blocks and features headed your way. This month we showcased one of the more unique items on the list, coming as part of the free portion of the 1.206 update - a large grid variant of the Small Inset Connector.

This block serves as an adapter which allows small grids equipped with the Small Connector to directly connect to large grids, vastly improving the docking experience for grids which utilize them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5134093/ca935fad2cb1a8a8d3897c4cff88f41dad7d93b5.gif[/img]

[b]Space Engineers 1 and Space Engineers 2 will coexist, each offering unique experiences for players.[/b]
